headline:
TAKE THE D7 BUS?
YOUR ROUTE COULD DISAPPEAR
deck: TfL proposes withdrawing the D7 bus route on the Isle of Dogs, sparking cross-party council opposition.
committee: Tower Hamlets Full Council Emergency Session

watchability.targetAudience: Isle of Dogs residents, bus commuters, parents, and George Green's School pupils
watchability.hookStyle: Immediate personal question and route identification within 2 seconds
watchability.pacingStyle: Punchy BBC Newsbeat / TikTok cadence (30-40s duration)
watchability.localRelevance: Direct impact on public transport connectivity across Millwall, Cubitt Town, and Canary Wharf

claims.statement: TfL is consulting on proposals to withdraw bus route D7 entirely and restructure routes 135, 277, and D6 on the Isle of Dogs.
claims.sourceQuote: As part of this, we are proposing to withdraw route D7 and restructure routes 135, 277 and D6 to ensure most journeys can still be taken.
claims.sourceDocument: TfL Isle of Dogs Bus Restructure Consultation

claims.statement: Tower Hamlets Council debated an emergency motion on 7 October 2026 opposing the proposed withdrawal of the D7 bus route.
claims.sourceQuote: Tower Hamlets Council debated the proposed withdrawal of the D7 bus route on the Isle of Dogs in an emergency session on Wednesday, 7 October 2026, with councillors expressing significant concern.

claims.statement: Councillors highlighted the D7's 120-year history and warned of impacts on school journeys to George Green's Secondary School.
claims.sourceQuote: Councillor Maium Talukdar, proposing the emergency motion, highlighted that the withdrawal of the D7 bus route was not a routine timetable adjustment but the removal of a 120-year-old transport link connecting Blackwall, Cubitt Town, and Millwall.

claims.statement: TfL stated passenger demand has fallen, while the public consultation remains open until Monday 16 November 2026.
claims.sourceQuote: Demand for bus services has fallen and we want the service we provide to better match usage... The closing date for comments is Monday 16 November 2026.

postcodeTag: E14 · ISLE OF DOGS · CANARY WHARF · CUBITT TOWN
coordinates: 51.4984° N, 0.0162° W · ISLE OF DOGS & POPLAR

takeawayCard.title: Public Consultation Closes 16 November
takeawayCard.subtitle: No final decision has been made. Passengers can submit feedback on TfL's website.

keyPoints: Vital service connecting Blackwall, Cubitt Town, and Millwall.
Direct daily route for pupils attending George Green's Secondary School.
Essential connection for non-car owners accessing clinics and workplaces.
